desc: Parse input: read T, then per test read N K and the N triples (X,Y,Z).
Per test: compute m_i=max(X,Y,Z) and base color = argmax coordinate (deterministic tie-break); sort items by m desc; T=first 2K; G=sum m_i; compute base parity over T.
If parity empty output G; else set {p,q}=odd colors, r=third, and build candidate recolor ops (item in T, base b->target d, cost m_i-w_{i,d}).
Build candidate swap ops (remove i in T base b, add j not in T target d, cost m_i-w_{j,d}) using few smallest m_i per base and few largest w_{j,d} outside per target.
Compute min loss = min(single op boundary {p,q}, or two ops boundaries {p,r}+{r,q} with all ids distinct); output G - min_loss.
Run brute-force reference vs main solution on random small cases (N≤8, values 0..6 with ties) plus edge cases (M=N, all-identical items); no mismatch found and both public samples pass.
